# Vision Energy International

> Authorised UAE engineering specialist and supplier focused primarily on Lightning Protection Systems and Earthing & Grounding Networks (IEC 62305, BS EN 62305, BS EN 62561, NF C 17-102, BS 7430, NFPA 780), with secondary project supply and technical support for Commercial Gym Equipment and Laboratory Equipment across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the GCC.

## Company Overview & Geographic Scope
- **Legal Entity**: VISION ENERGY INTERNATIONAL
- **Headquarters**: RAK Business Centre BC4, Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
- **Service Region**: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Ajman, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain (UAE & GCC)
- **UAE Regulatory Alignment**: DEWA (Dubai Electricity & Water Authority), SEWA (Sharjah Electricity & Water Authority), ADDC (Abu Dhabi Distribution Company), DoE (Department of Energy), ADCDA (Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority), Abu Dhabi Municipality
- **Hours**: Monday–Saturday, 08:00–18:00 (GST / UTC+4)
- **Primary Contact**: `+971 7 204 2763` | `+971 50 768 6700` | `info@visionenergyme.com`

## Priority #1 Technical Expertise
- [Engineering Expertise Overview](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise): Full interactive guide covering Lightning Protection Systems, Earthing & Equipotential Bonding, Surge Protection Coordination, and UAE regulatory workflows.
- [Markdown Specification of /expertise](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise.md): Agent-friendly Markdown reference with all protection tables, formulas (`Rp`, `Rp(h)`, Rolling Sphere Levels I–IV, Faraday Mesh grid dimensions, ESE `ΔT` radii), 10-stage delivery workflow, and direct FAQ answers.
- [Lightning Protection Tab](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise#lightning): 9-step engineering guide (formation, 6 risk profiles, 5 LPS effects, 6 engineered components, 6 core functions, risk criteria & Levels I–IV, Conventional vs. ESE vs. Meshed Cage comparison, UAE thunderstorm impact, before/during/after safety precautions).
- [Earthing & Grounding Tab](https://www.visionenergyme.com/expertise#earthing): 5-step engineering guide (soil resistivity study, deep electrodes & enhancement compounds, exothermic bonding, Type 1/2/3 SPD surge coordination, 10-stage project delivery, technical standards).
